T4.requirement: Validated IHDR/PLTE/tRNS context comes from the whole mathematical walk and borrowed input ranges.
All fifteen legal colour/depth formats use MSB-first sub-byte or big-endian 16-bit samples; padding is outside the pixel domain.
Low-depth RGBA8 scaling is exact and has zero remainder.
RGBA16 scaling is exact for all five depths.
Every 16-bit sample uses the specified half-up rounding identity for RGBA8.
tRNS keys are masked to their low d bits and compared with complete unscaled samples, with all three RGB keys tested.
Palette index bounds precede borrowed PLTE reads; missing alpha defaults to 255 and 16-bit palette/alpha bytes scale by 257.
Actual row conversion and successful public still/still16 pixels obey the independent MC channel and physical-byte equations at every position.
T4.qualification: The 22 successful still/still16 witnesses assert every frozen physical output byte. Full Still/Still16 record equality, including unrestricted info, remains M6.

T4.requirement: MC returns internal OutsideDomain (None), never a PNG format error, for invalid colour/depth pairs, unreachable PLTE/tRNS contexts, zero or above-PNG_WIRE_MAX/MAX_DIMENSION widths, rows with 4*width above MAX_OUTPUT, and non-exact scanline byte lengths. Every validated native draw_row call proves row_domain.
T4.qualification: PaletteSize::Allow permits more than 2^depth entries, up to 256; MC has no palette-size policy argument. The context domain admits that reachable policy case while Strict validation still returns InvalidPalette. Empty suggested-palette sequences represent absence; present empty wire PLTE remains InvalidPalette.

T8.requirement: The active native cache is exactly frame k−1’s rectangle and effective disposal, not merely a bounded rectangle.
Disposal NONE leaves bytes unchanged and BACKGROUND clears precisely the preceding rectangle in all RGBA channels.
PREVIOUS on frame zero becomes BACKGROUND, not NONE.
PREVIOUS restores the canvas independently derived before drawing frame k−1, after the preceding disposal; no Saved layout is prescribed.
Every Saved restore source load lies inside the rectangle written by the matching save.
The exhausted/fused dispatcher returns without applying the last frame disposal.
SOURCE and OVER use independent MC8 source pixels and the exact integer MOver equations.
T-OVER covers every byte operand, both alpha fast paths, positive divisor A, half-up channels/alpha, BLEND_MAX and u32 intermediate bounds.
Every actual public Ok(Some(view)) exports the canonical per-position MK step on view.pixels(), with the previous control and independent before-draw restore reference carried across calls.
T8.qualification: The public step and the 13 frozen frame projections include every returned canvas byte. Unrestricted returned frame records, complete MFr equality and Prog_ITER remain M6.

T8.requirement: Constructor canvas is transparent when the default is not an animation frame, otherwise it contains independently decoded default pixels; reused frame zero preserves the same MK source.

A_PNG_3_M5.requirement: Saved has canvas size 4WH ≤ MAX_OUTPUT ≤ MAX_BYTES; a decoder requests it at most once and its cumulative log has at most three entries.

A_PNG_4.requirement: The actual decoder owns the cumulative sealed log; without OOM its requests equal the pure-input initial requests plus the one reached Saved request, all successful.
Saved OOM occurs at mathematical SavedAt, retains the exact failed Saved suffix after successful constructor entries, exposes no frame and fuses all subsequent calls without new requests or decoding.
All entries Ok implies T-ITER items 1–3, including complete returned canvas and control payloads.

MC_domain_correction.context_rules: Legal colour/depth; no PLTE for CT0/4; CT2/3/6 PLTE length divisible by 3 and at most 768; indexed PLTE nonempty; tRNS length 2 for CT0, 6 for CT2, 1..=palette entries for CT3, forbidden for CT4/6.
MC_domain_correction.row_rules: 1 <= width <= PNG_WIRE_MAX and MAX_DIMENSION; 4*width <= MAX_OUTPUT; exact scan_bytes length.
MC_domain_correction.policy_boundary: PaletteSize::Allow palettes exceeding 2^depth remain in the context domain, with a checked four-entry/depth-one example and separate Strict InvalidPalette result.
MC_domain_correction.checked_header_derivation: decode_exact derives 4*w <= MAX_OUTPUT from w <= ihdr.w, positive ihdr.h and Ihdr::wf; loop invariants preserve this fact for pw <= w.
MC_domain_correction.arithmetic_stability: render_row_observe explicitly derives quotient/remainder coordinate equality; no solver limit or contract changed.

sensitivity_scope: All eight canonical contract results are retained historical evidence, not fresh mutant replays of this R3 domain correction. Historical 596 remains localized-only; this evidence does not replace the M6 campaign.
